title: Measurement as governance in and for responsible Al
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. This paper is a conceptual work on measurement and governance in AI and does not present or evaluate a benchmark related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not discuss religion or faith; therefore, there are no findings related to this topic.
